svg.title: RIEMANN · MAP T2 — The chain to Landau's theorem: from a theorem of 1905 up to the Riemann Hypothesis
svg.desc: One chain through the proof: 6 statements, each used by the proof of the next, from thm-landau-windows at depth 5 up to thm-riemann-hypothesis of Main.lean. It is a shortest chain in the blueprint's uses graph, found breadth-first from the three theorems nothing else uses, so every statement on it is as far from the main theorems as it can be. Read it as a proof, left to right and top to bottom: nothing is used before it is proved. Each card is one blueprint statement, as in the chapter posters; an arrow from A to B says that the proof of B uses A. This is the analytic end of the proof in six steps: Landau's theorem on Dirichlet series with non-negative coefficients turns a bound on windows into a zero-free half-plane, and the four reductions above it carry that half-plane to the Riemann Hypothesis. Map mode: nothing of the blueprint's text or the proof's source is quoted. No Lean was built: see diagram R1, band 5.

Title and pill. The title is the blueprint's; the pill gives the kind and the provenance: new in Alpöge's proof, modified from a published result, or published as it stands. Main.lean marks the theorems the
Comparator config names.

The line in italics gives the statement's id and how many paragraphs the blueprint spends on its statement and its proof. The text itself is not quoted: it is the blueprint's authors', and the blueprint link in the
footer has it. The Lean signature is not quoted either, for the same reason; the footer gives the declaration's name, file and line in the mirror.
Stated with, Proof uses and Used by are the blueprint's edges, in full. An arrow from A to B: the proof of B uses A, and the arrow takes A's colour.

The chain, in reading order: 1. thm-landau-windows (From prime sums to the zero-free half-plane, depth 5); 2. thm-zero-free-from-windows (From prime sums to the zero-free half-plane, depth 4); 3. thm-zero-free-from-connected (From prime sums to the zero-free half-plane, depth 3); 4.
thm-grh-from-galois (The proof in outline, depth 2); 5. thm-half-plane (The main theorems, depth 1); 6. thm-riemann-hypothesis (The main theorems, depth 0).
The chapters it crosses, in order: chap-zero-free → architecture → main-theorems.
Depth counts uses edges from the main theorems: thm-landau-windows is at depth 5, the deepest statement on the chain. The blueprint's deepest statement of all is at depth 10.
Left to right, then the next row. The last card is the theorem of Main.lean the chain reaches.
